description: Frozen coverage-derived mask selections for original g050 foundations under original elegant/casual clothes. Apply only to the exact source assets; this does not fit cloth or alter any geometry.

authoringContract.chart: per-foundation-triangle constant nearest-body geometric normal; plane through foundation centroid
authoringContract.projectedOpeningMargin: Minkowski sum with a 1 mm half-extent square, containing a 1 mm disk
authoringContract.outerDepthReference: triangle centroid plane, not varying per-point foundation depth
authoringContract.qualification: Union of projected outward-facing outer-cloth triangles covers the full expanded foundation triangle; uncovered area <= 1e-14 square metres
authoringContract.poseQualification: Authored plus actual Avatar at 0 s and 4 s; all 23,300 additional triangle records were requalified on captured actual positions
authoringContract.vertexRule: a new flag is allowed only when every currently drawn incident triangle qualifies; exact additional removal set is stored
limitations: Local projection and two poses are not all-view or all-motion occlusion.
Source labels already set above 0.5 are retained; only additional qualified flags are applied.
Coarse-source zero-label gaps and subdivision/any-corner mismatch are distinct inputs to the coverage transfer.
Clothed actual 32 states have zero decency exposures. Eight foundation-only states retain the unchanged 4787/4788 GROIN ray red with no active outer mask.
Residual inner/outer contacts, original outer-cloth/body contacts and sock/showcase layering defects remain.

containerPreservation: Portable files preserve the original GLB container bytes. Their parsed JSON and complete BIN are identical to the rendered scratch candidates, whose JSON serialization was 60 bytes shorter.
